contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' contributions (63.26) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (63.26) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (63.26); Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the same 63.26 because this is the cycle's only report on this cover (line 3 Balance at Beginning is a slashed zero)
contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows sum to 63.26 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 63.26 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell (Column A). Row 1 is the filer's own AGGREGATE line — date 'VARIOUS', contributor '< $50.00', address 'VARIOUS', amount 63.26 — kept as ONE row and never split into imagined donors. Rows 2 and 3 are the filer's category lines 'GOODS OR SERVICES' and 'IN KIND', each carrying a SLASHED ZERO in the amount cell, read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling; they contribute nothing to the sum but they are printed rows of the schedule and they are what makes the in-kind test decidable here. Column B is NOT summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime); it happens to equal Column A because this is the cycle's first and only report.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures (48.11) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (48.11) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' (48.11)
expenditures.detail: 2 Schedule B rows sum to 3.79 + 44.32 = 48.11 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A. The cover's whole balance ladder closes on these figures too: line 3 (slashed zero = 0) + line 4 63.26 = line 5 63.26, minus line 6 48.11 = line 7 15.15, as printed. Column B YTD 48.11 is retained as cumulative and never summed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY AND MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND ARE IDENTICAL HERE, AND THE FILER SAYS SO HIMSELF — tested both ways as the brief requires. Schedule A carries an explicit printed 'IN KIND' line whose amount is a SLASHED ZERO (0), and an explicit 'GOODS OR SERVICES' line likewise zero, so the in-kind component of this filing is stated to be nil and both conventions close at 63.26. This is the rare filing where the per-filer in-kind question is answered on the page instead of inferred from arithmetic.
itemized.escalation_note: No cell needed settling: the hand is large block capital printing and every figure was legible at 200 dpi full page. The six 900 dpi crops taken are the mandatory geometry controls recorded in the frames.

The only nil marks on the filing are SLASHED ZEROS (line 3 of the summary, and the two zero category lines on Schedule A) plus BARE DASHES in the Date and Address cells of those two lines; read per line per the B2 caution — the slashed zeros are 0, the bare dashes are BLANK.

His entire Schedule A is one sub-threshold AGGREGATE line ('< $50.00' / 'VARIOUS' / 'VARIOUS' / 63.26) plus two explicit zero category lines. So a reconciling, fully transcribed contribution side can still name no donor at all — the empty donor identity here is the DOCUMENT's, not the transcription's.
